findings.detail: Tool "review_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "review_code_closer" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: review_code, review_code_closer, seo_audit · Public sink: seo_audit, skill_health, skill_discovery.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: review_code, review_code_closer, seo_audit · Public sink: seo_audit, skill_health, skill_discovery

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "review_code" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
